description: Drop a player's head when they die

Drop Head is a project to drop a player's head when they die.

## How it works ?
### Edit player loot table `entities/player.json`
Adds a player head to the death of a player and correlates the characteristics of this dead player

## Complementary
You can also use [Killer Head](https://modrinth.com/project/killer-head).
Here's [Stackable Heads](https://modrinth.com/project/stackable-heads) which is interesting to use.

## Compatibility
**Drop Head** should work anywhere.
